visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a blonde toddler sitting at a wooden table in a bright kitchen. He is wearing a blue shirt and a beige silicone bib. A green Kikkoman soy milk carton stands on the table next to him. (2) The toddler holds a clear glass with both hands and drinks the soy milk, tilting his head back. (3) After finishing, he looks up at the camera with a satisfied expression, vocalizing, and then tips the glass completely upside down over his mouth to get the last drops. (4) The toddler gets down from the chair and walks across the light wood floor toward an open dishwasher. (5) He carefully places the glass into the bottom rack of the dishwasher. (6) Finally, he stands up and uses both hands to push the dishwasher door upward, slamming it shut with a determined expression.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a heartwarming and impressive moment of a toddler drinking soy milk and demonstrating responsibility by putting his glass in the dishwasher and closing it himself.
